title: Hot Cocoa Mix

adjustment.analysis: No events, promotions, or price changes are scheduled. Recent sales show a slight upward trend (29 units last week vs baseline 28.4), but no named driver justifies a shift. No evidence supports moving the median. Confidence is high due to consistent baseline and lack of drivers.
